name: CadError
doc: The application refused a request; the message is the one shown in the application.

name: connect
doc: Point cadkit at an application instance. Normally not needed: it finds the running one by itself.

name: call
doc: Call any application tool by name (the same tools the MCP bridge offers) and return its result.

name: tools
doc: Return the application automation tools and their argument schemas.

name: Obj
doc: An object in the document. Returned by every modeling call; pass it (or its name) to the next one.

members.name: to_dict
members.doc: Everything the application reported about this object (bounds, size, volume, faces ...).

name: run
doc: Run any modeling command: ``run("fillet", slots={"Edges": [...]}, radius=2)``. Returns the new Obj list.

name: objects
doc: Every object in the document.

name: view
doc: Set the camera to a standard view ("front", "top", "iso" ...); fit=True zooms to everything.

name: screenshot
doc: Capture the application window (the application answers with the picture data).

name: history
doc: Group everything inside the block into one undo step: ``with cad.history("Make bracket"): ...``

name: dialog
doc:
Show a dialog and wait for OK. ``fields`` are dicts: {"key", "label", "type": "number|text|check|choice", "value", ...}.
Returns {key: value} or None if the user cancelled.

name: ask
doc:
The quick way to ask for numbers and options. The kind of field follows the default you give:
``cad.ask("Plate", width=60, depth=40, name="Plate 1", rounded=True, material=["Steel", "Aluminum"])``.
Returns a dict of the answers (numbers keep int or float as given), or None if cancelled.

name: sketch
doc: Start a sketch on 'XY', 'XZ', 'YZ', a construction plane's name, or a face ``{"object": "Box 1", "face": 6}``.

name: flatten
doc: Create a persistent flat layout. Select it later with refold() to return.

name: refold
doc: Refold a saved layout; optionally wrap curves, sheets or solids onto it.

name: wrap
doc:
Map geometry between a planar reference and a surface, or between curves.

U/V/normal scales and offsets, mirror_u, swap_uv, flip_normal,
keep_input_geometry and curve_tolerance are accepted keyword arguments.

name: extrude
doc: Extrude a sketch or face. ``extent`` can be "Two sides", "Symmetric", "To object", "Through all" ...; ``operation`` "Cut" etc.

name: fillet
doc: ``edges`` as in ``{"object": "Box 1", "edge": 3}`` or a list of them (edge numbers start at 1).

name: image
doc: Put a picture on a plane as a reference. ``on`` is "Front plane (XZ)", "Top plane (XY)" or "Right plane (YZ)".

name: edit_image
doc: Change a picture: opacity, width, turn, move_right, move_up, mirror_left_to_right ...

name: flange
doc: Bent sheet metal from a sketch of the cross-section (straight lines, sharp corners).

name: drawing
doc: Write an engineering drawing (.svg, .pdf or .dxf); see the drawing_export tool for the options.

name: form_box
doc: Create an editable subdivision box; accepts width, depth, height, faces_x/y/z.

name: form_cylinder
doc: Create an editable cylinder cage; accepts radius, height, sides, rings, caps.

name: form_loft
doc: Loft an editable cage through ordered curve/sketch sections.

name: form_pipe
doc: Build an editable round tube along a curve/edge.

name: form_info
doc: Read a cage and its topology diagnostics; component indices are zero-based.

name: form_op
doc: Undoable cage edit: e.g. bridge, set_vertices, inset, crease, move or insert_loop.

name: form_to_nurbs
doc: Convert a cage to NURBS in place; save the editable form first if needed.

name: show
doc: Print objects or results as compact JSON: the most complete thing an agent can read back.

name: faces
doc:
Find faces by geometry instead of index: faces(b, type="Plane", facing=(0, 0, 1)). Returns the tool's JSON
(indices are 1-based, ready for fillet/chamfer/shell/hole slots). See help("solid_find") for every filter.

name: edges
doc: Find edges by geometry: edges(b, direction=(0, 0, 1), min_size=10). Same filters as faces().

name: check
doc: Verify a body (validity, volume, closed, thin walls ...), or measure between obj and other. Returns JSON.

name: commands
doc: Names run() accepts, optionally those containing query.

name: describe
doc: The slots (what to select) and parameters (name, type, default, range, options) of a command, as JSON.

name: help
doc: Search the commands and the cadkit functions for query and print a short answer.

name: holes
linear_pattern
doc: Copy objects along one or two directions. Directions are "X axis", "Y axis" or "Z axis". Returns the new objects.
signature: linear_pattern(objects, count=4, spacing=20, direction='X axis', count2=1, spacing2=20, direction2='Y axis', **p)

name: circular_pattern
doc:
Copy objects around an axis through the world origin (axis_passes_through="Center of the objects" to use their centre).
result="Join into a body" or "Cut from a body" fuses or cuts the copies instead of leaving new bodies.

name: rib
doc: Add a rib from a sketched line or open profile to the body it touches.

name: split_body
doc: Split a body with a plane, face, surface or another solid.

name: push_pull
doc: Move planar faces along their normal: positive pulls out, negative pushes in.

name: delete_face
doc: Remove faces (a hole, fillet or pocket) and heal the body.

name: cam_setup
doc: Stock, work zero and default tool for machining a body: stock_allowance_xy, top_allowance, tool_diameter, cutting_feed ...

name: cnc_profile
doc: Cut along outlines. depth = total cutting depth; also tool_diameter, cutting_feed, depth_per_pass, cut="..."

name: cnc_adaptive
doc: Pocket with even tool load (faster, deeper).

name: cnc_face
doc: Face the stock top.

name: cnc_finish
doc: 3D parallel finishing over a model (cutter="Ball nose" by default).

name: cnc_rough
doc: Layered 3D roughing of setup stock with a flat end mill and finishing allowance.

name: cnc_post
doc: Write G-code for the toolpaths in the document. machine: "GRBL", "Mach3" or "LinuxCNC".

name: print_export
doc:
Write the model for a slicer. format: "3MF", "STL", "OBJ" or "PLY"; open_in: "Bambu Studio", "OrcaSlicer", "PrusaSlicer"
or "Save only". Same file name each time, so the slicer can reload from disk.

name: fdm_check
doc: Screen a CAD body or mesh for bed fit, nozzle walls and overhangs.

name: resin_check
doc: Sample resin cavities, potential cups, islands and thin features; sampling_size sets grid resolution.

name: cnc_design_check
doc: Screen top-down access, reach and wall thickness.

name: cnc_stock_review
doc: Sample visible milling paths in the active setup and program order.

name: resin_export
doc: Export for an external resin slicer; supports/exposure are configured there.
